Golden images / shared VM templates
  -> one embedded credential, copied into every instance

Shared secrets (API keys, connection strings)
  -> blast radius multiplied by every app that trusts it

Broadly-scoped IAM roles ("just give it Contributor")
  -> bounded only by the subscription, not the task
